Select element with options produces readable output

```zig title="Zig"
const std = @import("std");
const html_to_markdown_rs = @import("html_to_markdown_rs");

pub fn main() !void {
    const _result_json = try html_to_markdown_rs.convert("<form><label>Color:</label><select><option value=\"red\">Red</option><option value=\"blue\" selected>Blue</option><option value=\"green\">Green</option></select></form>", "{\"preprocessing\":{\"remove_forms\":false}}");
    defer std.heap.c_allocator.free(_result_json);
    std.debug.print("{s}\n", .{_result_json});

}
```
